relink.name: openregister:registers:relink-schemas
relink.description: Rebuild a register's schemas list from its physical object tables (dry run by default)
options: Apply the changes. Without this flag nothing is modified.
Limit to a single register id.

dedupe.name: openregister:registers:dedupe-shared-schemas
dedupe.description: Split schema entities shared by several registers so each owns its own (dry run by default)
options: Apply the changes. Without this flag nothing is modified.
Limit to shared schemas involving this register id.
Name the owner of a schema attribution could not settle: <schemaId>:<registerId>, or a bare <registerId> for all of them. Repeatable.
Refuse any split whose source table has a column with no destination.
